releaseNotes:
LifeOS v2.0.7 (Build 31):
• Added (+ Add Expense) directly in recent expenses list
• Added Money Lent tracker for personal loans (excluded from total spending)
• Material 3 Expressive Greeting screen with live M3 animations & Gmail username
• Official M3 Expressive wavy continuous sine-wave progress bar
• WorkManager background update notifications without opening app
• Expandable notification bar with Enlarge/Read More and Close options
• Eliminated black screen on route transitions with concurrent popLayout crossfade
• Fixed repeated system notification permission prompts on launch
• 120 FPS high refresh-rate GPU compositing & touch acceleration
